verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has no built-in natural-language interface. Its documented built-in MCP server does let external AI assistants work with error, performance and log data, so users can issue natural-language commands through their own AI tool. Documented actions include browsing issues, inspecting stack traces, resolving issues and detecting N+1 queries. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, evidence that MCP covers broader operations (project/team/alert setup, releases), and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL operation.
